# Tensorcraft

> Interactive, story-driven ML education for JavaScript developers. Learn browser-based machine learning through JavaScript, TypeScript, and tools you already know.

## What is Tensorcraft?

Tensorcraft is a web application that teaches machine learning to JavaScript developers. It uses a unique "bridge" methodology - mapping familiar JavaScript concepts (like useState, Array.map, middleware chains, fetch) to their ML equivalents (model weights, tensor ops, inference API). Each course is a narrative world where learners build real ML models that run entirely in the browser using TensorFlow.js.

## Key Facts

- Deep Orbit is available now: 11 modules, 56 lessons, 65 in-browser coding exercises
- Four more worlds are coming soon
- 50+ JavaScript-to-ML concept bridges
- Deep Orbit costs $79 at the introductory price, with a $99 regular price. One payment gives lifetime access.
- The first five lessons of Deep Orbit are free, with no account required
- Light and dark mode
- Built with Next.js 16, TensorFlow.js, Supabase, Stripe

## The 5 Worlds

1. Deep Orbit (Space) - Time-Series & Signals - Build a deep-space signal classifier with RNNs/LSTMs
2. Neon Protocol (Cyberpunk), coming soon - Computer Vision
3. Signal Ward (Medical), coming soon - NLP & Text Intelligence
4. Nova Canvas (Creative AI), coming soon - Multimodal & Generative
5. Terra Grid (Industrial), coming soon - Edge AI & Production ML

## Who It's For

JavaScript developers who want to add machine learning to their skillset without switching to Python: in the browser, in Node, in React. Each bridge analogy maps a JS/TS concept to its ML equivalent.
